title: Authorized Users and Site Access Allowances: Bluegate Business Storage Account
content:
**Applies to:** every program of the Bluegate Business Storage Account. Authorized users are the employees who may hold gate access and act for the account. The number allowed, the fee for adding one after the account opens, and the site privileges that come with the program are as follows.

| Program | Authorized users allowed | Fee per authorized user added after opening | 24-hour gate access for authorized users | Loading dock use | Flatbed carts and dollies | Named account manager |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | 2 | $10.00 | No | No | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Business Plus | 4 | $10.00 | No | No | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Business Pro | 8 | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | 12 | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | 12 | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Business National Account | 50 | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Notes

- The fee per added user is charged per user added after the account opens; on Pro and every program above it the figure is $0.00.
- Carts and dollies are available on every program. 24-hour gate access and loading dock use begin at Pro. A named account manager begins at Logistics.

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Bluegate Business Plus account adds 2 authorized users after opening: 2 users at $10.00 each, $20.00 in total.
- A Bluegate Business Pro account adds 3 authorized users after opening: the fee per user is $0.00, so nothing is charged.
- A Bluegate Business Essentials account already has 2 authorized users: that is the 2 its program allows.
